title: Extent of Surgical Trauma in Open and Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: The aim of this work is to evaluate which of the two types of operation (traditional/open and laparoscopic) has more impact on patients who were operated electively due to their chronic calculous cholecystitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronic Calculous Cholecystitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous Biliary Surgery
* Cholangitis
* Obstructive jaundice
